proof_body:
by
  intro a b hab f f' n hn hd hi hp
  have h := fourierCoeffOn_of_hasDerivAt hab hn hd hi
  rw [← hp, sub_self, mul_zero, zero_sub] at h
  haveI : Fact (0 < b - a) := ⟨sub_pos.mpr hab⟩
  have hba : 0 < b - a := sub_pos.mpr hab
  have hn' : 0 < |(n : ℝ)| := abs_pos.mpr (by exact_mod_cast hn)
  have hbound : ‖fourierCoeffOn hab f' n‖ ≤ (b - a)⁻¹ * ∫ x in a..b, ‖f' x‖ := by
    rw [fourierCoeffOn_eq_integral, norm_smul]
    have h1 : ‖∫ x in a..b, fourier (-n) (x : AddCircle (b - a)) • f' x‖ ≤ ∫ x in a..b, ‖f' x‖ := by
      refine (intervalIntegral.norm_integral_le_integral_norm hab.le).trans (le_of_eq ?_)
      congr 1
      funext x
      rw [norm_smul, fourier_apply, Circle.norm_coe, one_mul]
    have h2 : ‖((1 / (b - a) : ℝ))‖ = (b - a)⁻¹ := by
      rw [Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos (by positivity), one_div]
    rw [h2]
    exact mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_left h1 (by positivity)
  rw [h, norm_mul, norm_neg, norm_mul]
  have h3 : ‖(1 : ℂ) / (-2 * Real.pi * Complex.I * n)‖ = 1 / (2 * Real.pi * |(n : ℝ)|) := by
    simp [abs_of_pos Real.pi_pos]
  have h4 : ‖(b : ℂ) - a‖ = b - a := by
    rw [← Complex.ofReal_sub, Complex.norm_real, Real.norm_eq_abs, abs_of_pos hba]
  rw [h3, h4]
  have hpos : 0 < 2 * Real.pi * |(n : ℝ)| := by positivity
  calc 1 / (2 * Real.pi * |(n : ℝ)|) * ((b - a) * ‖fourierCoeffOn hab f' n‖)
      ≤ 1 / (2 * Real.pi * |(n : ℝ)|) * ((b - a) * ((b - a)⁻¹ * ∫ x in a..b, ‖f' x‖)) := by
        gcongr
    _ = (∫ x in a..b, ‖f' x‖) / (2 * Real.pi * |(n : ℝ)|) := by
        field_simp
target_source: ∀ (a b : ℝ) (hab : a < b) (f f' : ℝ → ℂ) (n : ℤ), n ≠ 0 → (∀ x ∈ Set.uIcc a b, HasDerivAt f (f' x) x) → IntervalIntegrable f' MeasureTheory.volume a b → f a = f b → ‖fourierCoeffOn hab f n‖ ≤ (∫ x in a..b, ‖f' x‖) / (2 * Real.pi * |(n : ℝ)|)
